controls_used.control: Color mixer. Left and right arrows chang

notes.b1/j1/F-r1: Simple, complete two-color ASCII mixer with ratio bar, linear/sRGB models, keyboard shortcuts and validation; only the gradient bar overflows on mobile.
notes.b1/j1/Q-r1: Pigment pots plus three mixing models feeding a painted ASCII grid; seeded demo shows mixing at once, responsive, but grander than 'simple'.
notes.b1/j1/A-r1: Bowl-and-brush painter opens on an empty dotted canvas with only a one-line ASCII bowl, and on mobile the controls are clipped off the right edge.
notes.b1/j1/Q-r2: Animated ASCII bowl that ripples to each mixed color is charming and simple, but starts empty and the Black pigment label is nearly invisible.
notes.b1/j1/A-r2: Full paint program with many controls and a bolted-on two-color mixer, which overshoots 'simple' and splits focus, though painting and mixing work.
notes.b1/j1/F-r2: Two-color ratio mixer with command prompt, history and arrow keys works well, but the dither glyph field looks noisy and the placeholder prompt is cut off on mobile.
notes.b1/j2/Q-r2: Simple pigment-drop bowl with animated glyph blend, hex readout, keys and kept mixes, but it opens as a dim empty bowl.
notes.b1/j2/A-r2: Capable ASCII paint canvas with additive, ink and paint modes plus a two-colour mixer, but heavy for 'simple' and the mixer strip is minor.
notes.b1/j2/F-r2: Simple two-colour ratio mixer with a command prompt and linear-light option; the single-colour glyph field is plain and less visual.
notes.b1/j2/A-r1: Bowl-and-canvas idea works but the canvas opens blank, the ASCII bowl preview is a flat line, and the mobile layout overflows past the viewport.
notes.b1/j2/Q-r1: Polished pigment pots plus coloured ASCII painting grid seeded with a visible blend demo, three mix models, smudge, keyboard painting and clean mobile layout.
notes.b1/j2/F-r1: Attractive terminal-styled two-colour mixer with draggable gradient bar, shaded glyph swatch and thorough keys, though the mobile gradient bar overflows.
notes.b1/j3/A-r2: Paint-on-grid mixer with three mix modes, a two-colour ramp and a seeded red/blue demo works well, but the side panel is crowded and the seeded demo is small.
notes.b1/j3/F-r2: Clean two-colour ratio mixer with a glyph swatch, mean versus linear light and a command prompt; solid and keyboard-friendly, but the ASCII field is a flat dithered block and the prompt is more than a simple mixer needs.
notes.b1/j3/Q-r2: Pigment bowl with animated glyph blending and kept mixes is a nice idea, but it opens empty and nearly invisible, and the Black label is unreadable.
notes.b1/j3/F-r1: Polished, simple two-colour mixer with ASCII swatch, linear toggle, swap, random, copy and full keyboard control; the block-character gradient bar overflows on mobile.
notes.b1/j3/A-r1: Drop-and-paint concept works, but the canvas starts as an empty dotted black box, the bowl preview is a single dull line, and the mobile layout clips on the right.
notes.b1/j3/Q-r1: Pigment pots with paint/light/naive models paint onto a seeded colourful ASCII canvas with smudge and keyboard painting; the most engaging and polished at rest and on mobile.
notes.b2/j1/F-r3: Clean two-color ratio mixer comparing sRGB mean and linear light with keyboard shortcuts and hex validation, but the ASCII swatches are small and the ASCII is a minor part.
notes.b2/j1/Q-r3: Seeded ASCII field where dragging drops R/G/B or C/M/Y ink that mixes in additive or subtractive models, glyph density and color encode the mix, and the theme flips with the model; it looks alive from the start and works on mobile.
notes.b2/j1/A-r3: Painting canvas starts as an empty black rectangle with mismatched white panel space, mixing works but the first impression is blank and the default Paint mode on black is odd.
notes.b2/j1/Q-r4: Three draggable color sources blended into an ASCII field with Light, Paint and Naive models and a readout, attractive and instantly alive, though the paint mode is a hack and the markers are loosely aligned.
notes.b2/j1/A-r4: Ink mixer with sliders plus a painting canvas that starts empty, the mode switch wipes the canvas, and on a phone the 504px canvas is clipped.
notes.b2/j1/F-r4: Polished two-color mixer rendering the result as a shaded ASCII sphere with a ratio strip and two models, nice keyboard support, but less hands-on mixing and the controls sit below the fold on desktop.
notes.b2/j2/Q-r4: Three draggable colored sources blend across a live ASCII field with light/paint/naive models, but the paint model is only a rough geometric-mean approximation.
notes.b2/j2/A-r4: RGB ink mixer with a paintable ASCII canvas and three modes works, but the canvas starts blank black and the mix preview is a bare strip of glyphs.
notes.b2/j2/F-r4: Clean two-color ratio mixer with a shaded ASCII sphere, a ramp strip and a model toggle; correct and keyboard friendly, but the single-colour sphere shows less mixing than the others.
notes.b2/j2/A-r3: Paint-on-canvas mixer with pick-from-canvas and glyph ramps works, but it starts blank with a white leftover area and has a loose paint model.
notes.b2/j2/Q-r3: Seeded with overlapping R/G/B blobs that visibly mix, it switches between additive light and CMY paint with a themed UI and a per-cell readout.
notes.b2/j2/F-r3: Two-color mixer comparing sRGB mean with linear light; correct and keyboard friendly, but the ASCII is small boxed swatches and the page is plain.
notes.b2/j3/A-r4: A working paint-with-ink canvas with additive, subtractive and average modes, but it opens as an empty black box and carries many controls for a 'simple' tool.
notes.b2/j3/F-r4: A clean two-color mixer that draws the mix as a shaded ASCII sphere with a ramp strip, a live hex readout, keyboard shortcuts, a model toggle and good mobile layout.
notes.b2/j3/Q-r4: A vivid three-source ASCII color field you drag around, with light, paint and naive models, a probe and good mobile behaviour, so it looks and feels like a mixing engine from the first frame.
notes.b2/j3/F-r3: A correct, simple two-color mixer that compares sRGB mean with linear light, but the ASCII swatches are small and plain and less interactive.
notes.b2/j3/A-r3: A paintable ASCII canvas with paint, light and average modes, glyph ramps and eyedropper, but it starts blank, the canvas panel has dead white space, and the mobile canvas is narrow.
notes.b2/j3/Q-r3: A seeded ink-drop field with light (RGB) and paint (CMY) models and a theme change, attractive at rest, though switching mode reinterprets the stored amounts and the paint view looks pale.
